decisive_items: Figure 1 Title: Squamous cell carcinoma from a mediastinal mass
response.rationale: R4 is the only candidate with definitive pathological evidence (IHC P40 positive, squamous cell carcinoma from mediastinal mass) directly matching the vignette's most likely diagnosis. R3 is a secondary finding (pulmonary emboli) but not the primary diagnosis. R1 and R2 are incidental lab abnormalities without diagnostic specificity.

rejected.why: Low hemoglobin alone is not specific to the most likely diagnosis; it is a nonspecific finding.
Elevated creatinine indicates renal impairment but does not explain the mediastinal mass or IHC results.
Pulmonary emboli are a complication of the mediastinal mass, not the underlying diagnosis.
